selected_architecture.pure_policy: Closed provider-neutral validation of detached bytes, exact relations, chronology, process derivation, and prepare/publish continuity. It performs no I/O and never claims human verification or effect authority.
selected_architecture.native_windows_helper: Actual handle/process/clock primitives plus a separately identified disposable-NTFS test path. It is not the canonical Hosea launcher and cannot create production provenance.
selected_architecture.sealed_hosea_launcher: A later zero-argument production adapter must verify the component lock before importing helpers, load the exact static allowlist, resolve all physical paths itself, and expose no provider, path, label, process, freeze, or authorization injection.
selected_architecture.wrapper_and_lease: A later wrapper owns the nonserializable in-process handle lease, independently retained prepare digests, transaction kernel, rooted replacement, and recovery-required state.
selected_architecture.owner_gate: A product or human channel outside local JSON must supply the exact one-shot decision. The current workspace has no mechanism that makes this cryptographic; every artifact must say so.

detached_freezes.component_lock: Created only after code, relevant tests, runtime helpers, contract, prior rejections, and fresh independent component reviews have exact hashes.
detached_freezes.execution_freeze: Created only after component lock and wrapper are independently green and after the separately authorized pre-restart identity capture. It binds exact file/root/process/environment identities and the pre-freeze boot.
detached_freezes.noncircular_rule: Neither object contains its own digest. The later sealed launcher or trusted task runtime supplies the expected detached digest.

test_evidence_separation.pure_fixture_tests: Prove deterministic schema and negative relations only.
test_evidence_separation.real_windows_temp_root_tests: Prove native primitives on a new safe local NTFS fixture only.
test_evidence_separation.production_closure_tests: Prove the zero-argument Hosea launcher has no redirect or provider seam.
test_evidence_separation.forbidden_claim: A temp-root run must never be described as execution of the canonical Hosea production freeze.

current_implementation_scope: new V3 pure policy and focused adversarial tests
new V3 Windows native helper and safe temporary-root tests
new static allowlist and deterministic validation
no zero-argument canonical collection until its own static freeze and review
no wrapper integration until both component layers independently pass
unresolved_external_requirements: No model-authored local JSON can prove Lowell's identity or independently authorize an effect.
A genuinely non-model-forgeable one-shot owner capability is not currently established by repository code.
Execution-freeze identity capture, Windows restart, and OneDrive exit each require later exact authorization.
Residual lost-update and post-readback writer races remain a reasonable strict block even after deterministic repairs.
